title: Windows Folder Customizer
shortDescription: A WPF desktop utility for designing and applying custom Windows folder icons, combining image processing, WPF rendering, filesystem manipulation, and Windows shell integration.
overview: Windows Folder Customizer is a desktop application that turns Windows folder icon customisation into a visual workflow. Users can select a folder, choose and recolour a base design, overlay custom imagery, and apply the finished icon without manually creating ICO files or configuring Windows shell metadata.
problem: Changing a Windows folder icon manually involves creating an ICO file, placing it with the target folder, configuring desktop.ini correctly, and applying the required filesystem attributes. I wanted to automate that process behind a visual editor while exploring image manipulation, WPF rendering, and lower-level Windows shell behaviour.
solution: I built an interactive WPF editor that allows users to compose folder icons from configurable base designs and custom images. Pixel-level recolouring is performed using WriteableBitmap and direct bitmap buffer manipulation. The completed WPF canvas is rendered to an image, converted into an ICO file, and written alongside the target folder. The application then generates the required desktop.ini configuration and applies the relevant Windows file attributes so Explorer displays the generated icon.
outcome: The application reduces a multi-step Windows customisation process to a simple graphical workflow while demonstrating practical integration between WPF rendering, image processing, filesystem operations, and Windows Explorer.
highlights: Built an interactive WPF editor for composing custom folder icons from configurable designs and user-supplied imagery
Implemented pixel-level image recolouring with WriteableBitmap and direct bitmap buffer manipulation
Rendered dynamic WPF canvas content to image files and converted the result into Windows ICO format
Automated desktop.ini generation and the filesystem attributes required for Windows folder customisation
Integrated with Windows Explorer so generated icons are applied directly to the selected folder
